title: Crunchy Canadian Chicken Bites
description: A twist on traditional chicken nuggets, these bite-sized morsels are perfect for any Chinese-inspired meal. Crispy on the outside and juicy on the inside, they're sure to delight.
instructions: Preheat oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a shallow dish, mix together flour, soy sauce, and salt.
Dip each chicken piece into the flour mixture, coating evenly.
Carefully place coated chicken into the hot oil.
Fry for 5-7 minutes or until golden brown and cooked through.
Drain on paper towels and serve hot.
